t: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero
name: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Mitsubishi A6M Zero
description: Introduction and overview of the Mitsubishi A6M Zero: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Mitsubishi A6M Zero is a single-engine carrier fighter that dominated the Pacific sky in 1941-42 with unmatched range and agility. Its lightness came at the cost of armor and self-sealing tanks. 10,939 were built; as Allied tactics and aircraft improved, the Zero's advantages faded. Baseline facts: Single-engine Japanese carrier fighter; 10,939 built by Mitsubishi; dominated 1941-42 Pacific..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
